application: 1994 Ford F150 4.9L; Ford CII slipper-pump construction study

findings: Fiberglass-reinforced nylon reservoir enclosing pump housing
Swiveling quick-connect pressure-hose fitting below filler neck

architecture: Lower pressure plate with inner and outer seals
Valve cover, O-ring and cover retaining ring
not_yet_modeled: Production hydraulic passages and shaft splines

owner_photo.findings: Yellowed translucent reservoir, black cap and pump/pulley at LH front below upper radiator hose. Photograph establishes appearance and general location, not measured centers or internal geometry.

pulley_comparison.bore_basis: Inferred inches, explicitly not a verified dimension with sourced units
pulley_comparison.conflict: Manufacturer five-groove metadata conflicts with Ford instructions to seat all six belt ribs and Gates K060980 six-rib belt application. The model uses six illustrative grooves for the Ford belt; the Dorman metadata conflict is retained rather than silently corrected.
pulley_comparison.photo_review: Black dished steel pulley with raised press-fit hub; no separate center bolt. Photo was visually reviewed, but used neither as a scale drawing nor as resolution of groove-count metadata conflict.

limits: All pump dimensions and working clearances are illustrative
No verified production fit, contact motion, pressure, displacement or hydraulic circuit
Engine bracket and hoses remain unfinished
Installed pump part number and exact replacement-pulley groove compatibility remain unverified
